principles: Reuse the DONE gate exact dirty evaluation (no new classification) so the preflight can never diverge from it.
Keep the DONE gate verdict byte-identical: any extraction is a pure move, not a behavior change.
Fail-fast UX with honest framing -- a convenience gate, not a soundness gate.
Block only the policy BLOCKING categories (material_source, fixture); non-blocking categories pass.
drivers: Must NOT change the DONE verdict logic, materialHash computation, or the checkEvidenceFreshnessForGit write-time guard.
Single source of truth for dirty classification -- no second copy that can drift.
Minimal blast radius on the hot review_run_start path; fail-open if git status is unreadable.

options.name: A: extract readGitStatusLines + evaluateDirtyGitStatus into a new shared module (core/dirty-worktree-gate.ts); done-oracle + review-run both import it
pros: Does not pull the large done-oracle module into review-run import graph

options.name: B: export the 3 helpers from done-oracle.ts; review-run imports from done-oracle
cons: Couples review-run to the large done-oracle module

options.name: C: duplicate the git status read + classify/evaluate inside review-run
cons: Two copies of the dirty logic -> divergence risk; violates single-source principle

chosen: A: extract readGitStatusLines + evaluateDirtyGitStatus into a new shared module (core/dirty-worktree-gate.ts); done-oracle + review-run both import it
rationale: Option A satisfies single-source-of-truth and keeps the DONE verdict byte-identical (pure move), without coupling review-run to the whole done-oracle module. C risks divergence (two copies); B couples review-run to a large module and raises circular-import risk.

preMortem.scenario: The DONE gate verdict changes as a side effect of the extraction
preMortem.trigger: The move accidentally alters classifierOptionsForCheck / evaluateDirtyGitStatus semantics
preMortem.consequence: The DONE gate blocks or passes differently -> regression in an unrelated gate
preMortem.mitigation: Pure move (cut/paste + re-import), no logic edits; keep the existing DONE smoke green and add a regression assertion that the DONE gate verdict is unchanged for sample git statuses

preMortem.scenario: The preflight blocks when only non-blocking files are dirty (.lattice metadata)
preMortem.trigger: Blocking on all dirty categories instead of the policy BLOCKING set, or wrong classifier options
preMortem.consequence: Reviewers cannot start a run even when only metadata is dirty (false positive)
preMortem.mitigation: Reuse evaluateDirtyGate BLOCKING result (material_source + fixture only); smoke asserts only-metadata-dirty PASSES and clean PASSES

preMortem.scenario: Circular import / module load crash when review-run imports the new shared module
preMortem.trigger: The new module imports something that transitively imports review-run or done-oracle back
preMortem.mitigation: The shared module imports only the leaf modules (dirty-worktree, dirty-gate-policy); no back-edge to review-run/done-oracle; tsc build + smoke catch it

preMortem.scenario: The preflight throws where git status is unreadable (e.g. bare metadata root), breaking review_run_start that used to work
preMortem.trigger: readGitStatusLines returns ok:false and the preflight throws instead of degrading
preMortem.consequence: review_run_start fails in edge environments it previously tolerated
preMortem.mitigation: On a git-status read failure do NOT block (fail-open -- it is a convenience gate), mirroring how the DONE gate tolerates the same condition; smoke covers the unreadable-status case
